audit: Independent complete-hand table clearance from frozen candidate poses
method: For every calibrated convex component, evaluate the min/max of n_H dot vertices_zero plus q*(n_H dot translation_per_opening) plus transformed plane offset at holding and pre-opening. These linear-motion endpoints exactly bound plane clearance throughout modeled closing.
sample_face_normal_check_note: Independent nominal-face alignment only; does not replace full validator contact-region checks.
